# glsec
[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/glsec/glsec?cacheSeconds=3600)](https://github.com/glsec/glsec) ![sarif](https://shields.io/badge/-SARIF-orange) [![GitHub release (latest SemVer)](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/glsec/glsec?sort=semver)](https://github.com/glsec/glsec/releases) [![GitHub last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/glsec/glsec)](https://github.com/glsec/glsec/commits) [![GitHub commit activity](https://img.shields.io/github/commit-activity/y/glsec/glsec)](https://github.com/glsec/glsec/graphs/commit-activity/) [![GitHub contributors](https://img.shields.io/github/contributors/glsec/glsec)](https://github.com/glsec/glsec/graphs/contributors/)

Static security linter for GitLab CI/CD configuration files (GITLAB_GLSEC)

- Documentation: [https://github.com/glsec/glsec#megalinter](https://github.com/glsec/glsec#megalinter)
- Descriptor: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/glsec/glsec/main/mega-linter-plugin-glsec/glsec.megalinter-descriptor.yml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/glsec/glsec/main/mega-linter-plugin-glsec/glsec.megalinter-descriptor.yml)
- Maintainer: [Nicolai Ehrhardt](https://github.com/predictor2718)

> ⚠️ **Required items are missing in this plugin** (native mode): see [MegaLinter checks](#megalinter-checks).

**glsec** is a static security linter for GitLab CI/CD configuration. It finds script injection through user-controlled CI variables, unpinned images, includes and CI/CD Catalog components, leaked secrets, and other pipeline misconfigurations. Findings map to the OWASP Top 10 CI/CD Security Risks and CWE.

It runs offline and needs no GitLab API token.

## Configuration in MegaLinter

- Enable glsec by adding `GITLAB_GLSEC` in [ENABLE_LINTERS variable](https://megalinter.io/beta/configuration/#activation-and-deactivation)
- Disable glsec by adding `GITLAB_GLSEC` in [DISABLE_LINTERS variable](https://megalinter.io/beta/configuration/#activation-and-deactivation)

| Variable                                 | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Default value                                        |
|------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| GITLAB_GLSEC_ARGUMENTS                   | User custom arguments to add in linter CLI call<br/>Ex: `-s --foo "bar"`                                                                                                                                            |                                                      |
| GITLAB_GLSEC_COMMAND_REMOVE_ARGUMENTS    | User custom arguments to remove from command line before calling the linter<br/>Ex: `-s --foo "bar"`                                                                                                                |                                                      |
| GITLAB_GLSEC_FILTER_REGEX_INCLUDE        | Custom regex including filter<br/>Ex: `(src\|lib)`                                                                                                                                                                  | Exclude no file                                      |
| GITLAB_GLSEC_FILTER_REGEX_EXCLUDE        | Custom regex excluding filter<br/>Ex: `(test\|examples)`                                                                                                                                                            | Exclude no file                                      |
| GITLAB_GLSEC_CLI_LINT_MODE               | Override default CLI lint mode<br/>- `file`: Calls the linter for each file<br/>- `list_of_files`: Call the linter with the list of files as argument                                                               | `list_of_files`                                      |
| GITLAB_GLSEC_FILE_EXTENSIONS             | Allowed file extensions. `"*"` matches any extension, `""` matches empty extension. Empty list excludes all files<br/>Ex: `[".py", ""]`                                                                             | Exclude every file                                   |
| GITLAB_GLSEC_FILE_NAMES_REGEX            | File name regex filters. Regular expression list for filtering files by their base names using regex full match. Empty list includes all files<br/>Ex: `["Dockerfile(-.+)?", "Jenkinsfile"]`                        | `["\\.gitlab-ci\\.ya?ml", ".+\\.gitlab-ci\\.ya?ml"]` |
| GITLAB_GLSEC_PRE_COMMANDS                | List of bash commands to run before the linter                                                                                                                                                                      | None                                                 |
| GITLAB_GLSEC_POST_COMMANDS               | List of bash commands to run after the linter                                                                                                                                                                       | None                                                 |
| GITLAB_GLSEC_UNSECURED_ENV_VARIABLES     | List of env variables explicitly not filtered before calling GITLAB_GLSEC and its pre/post commands                                                                                                                 | None                                                 |
| GITLAB_GLSEC_DISABLE_ERRORS              | Run linter but consider errors as warnings                                                                                                                                                                          | `false`                                              |
| GITLAB_GLSEC_DISABLE_ERRORS_IF_LESS_THAN | Maximum number of errors allowed                                                                                                                                                                                    | `0`                                                  |
| GITLAB_GLSEC_TIMEOUT_SECONDS             | Maximum duration in seconds of the linter run, after which the linter process and its child processes are killed and reported as an error (exit code 124). Overrides LINTER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS. 0 disables the timeout | `300`                                                |
| GITLAB_GLSEC_CLI_EXECUTABLE              | Override CLI executable                                                                                                                                                                                             | `['glsec']`                                          |

## Use this plugin

Add the descriptor URL of the plugin to `PLUGINS` in `.mega-linter.yml`. MegaLinter installs the plugin when it starts, whatever the flavor:

```yaml
PLUGINS:
  - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/glsec/glsec/main/mega-linter-plugin-glsec/glsec.megalinter-descriptor.yml
```

## Behind the scenes

### How are identified applicable files

- File names (regex): `\.gitlab-ci\.ya?ml`, `.+\.gitlab-ci\.ya?ml`

<!-- markdownlint-disable -->
<!-- /* cSpell:disable */ -->
### How the linting is performed

- glsec is called once with the list of files as arguments (`list_of_files` CLI lint mode)

### Example calls

```shell
glsec .gitlab-ci.yml
```

```shell
glsec .gitlab-ci.yml deploy.gitlab-ci.yml
```


### Installation in Docker

MegaLinter runs these commands when it loads the plugin (only `RUN` instructions):

```dockerfile
RUN GLSEC_VERSION=1.29.0 && \
    case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64|amd64) GLSEC_ARCH=amd64 ;; aarch64|arm64) GLSEC_ARCH=arm64 ;; *) echo "glsec: unsupported architecture $(uname -m)" >&2 && exit 1 ;; esac && \
    GLSEC_ASSET="glsec_${GLSEC_VERSION}_linux_${GLSEC_ARCH}.tar.gz" && \
    GLSEC_URL="https://github.com/glsec/glsec/releases/download/v${GLSEC_VERSION}" && \
    GLSEC_TMP="$(mktemp -d)" && \
    wget -qO "${GLSEC_TMP}/${GLSEC_ASSET}" "${GLSEC_URL}/${GLSEC_ASSET}" && \
    wget -qO "${GLSEC_TMP}/checksums.txt" "${GLSEC_URL}/checksums.txt" && \
    awk -v f="${GLSEC_ASSET}" '$2 == f' "${GLSEC_TMP}/checksums.txt" > "${GLSEC_TMP}/sum" && \
    test -s "${GLSEC_TMP}/sum" && \
    (cd "${GLSEC_TMP}" && sha256sum -c sum) && \
    tar -xzf "${GLSEC_TMP}/${GLSEC_ASSET}" -C "${GLSEC_TMP}" glsec && \
    install -m 0755 "${GLSEC_TMP}/glsec" /usr/local/bin/glsec && \
    rm -rf "${GLSEC_TMP}"
```

## MegaLinter checks

These results last changed on 2026-11-28, and MegaLinter checks the plugins every day. The checks only look at the descriptor of the plugin: they do not review the plugin, nor the tool it runs.

### Required

Missing required items:

- **`native_install` declared and valid for the 5 native platforms** (`GITLAB_GLSEC`): Native mode (MegaLinter without Docker) can not install the linter. Declare `native_install`, listing each of linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/amd64, darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64 in `platforms` or in `unsupported` (with a reason)
